_notes.forbidden_allergens: GS1 allergen codes, e.g. AN tree nuts, AP peanuts, SA almond, SH hazelnut, AS sesame, AM milk, ML lactose, AW gluten
_notes.allergen_policy: may_contain and no_data: block | needs_approval | allow. Missing data is unknown, never allergen-free.
_notes.substitutions: allowed | with_approval | forbidden. Official substitutes must also be the same product category (fit check).
_notes.weights: Ranking only. Unknown delivery reliability is neutral (0.95) and shown as a flag instead.
_notes.auto_approve.max_unstated_detail_spread_: An unstated detail (fat %, fresh vs long-life) that moves the order by more than this goes to the approver
_notes.auto_approve.max_auto_eur_per_24h: What the agent may order alone in 24 h; unset = its per-order limit (fail closed)
_notes.unknown_reliability: allow | needs_approval for products without delivery history; unset = needs_approval (fail closed)
_notes.profile: Buyer defaults for details a request leaves open (e.g. milk: fat 1.5 %, shelf_life fresh | long_life | any). A preference: used only when matching products exist, never overrides the request, always shown
